title: Trace one on the scalar Q Chern adjunct
statement: For l,c,Y,Family and Reference r as in [def-sfb-rational-p1-scalar-chern-maps], with Y,P1(Y),W Noetherian and DiagonalTraceLocalizations, and l invertible on Y, transport the whole-system normalized completed Q Chern adjunct by the explicit realization and coefficient mates. Its composite with the native Q trace is the identity of the coefficient unit.

source.place: Second identity, scalar trace base change before tensoring with q*K.

proof.text: Apply completed_chern_degree to the whole-system normalized completed adjunct.

Apply the normalized realization trace square and the prescribed integral, rational and closure scalar trace squares. In each square use ct=1 and F(t)u=vt to prove that the explicit transported adjunct has degree one. Cancel the native right-derived comparison against its inverse in the trace.

theorem scalar_chern_q_degree
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (r : Reference l Y δ family)
    (a : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      r.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (ha : CompletedChernNormalized l r.tq.toPresentation a) :
    scalarQChern l c Y r a ≫
      trace (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c) (diagram l c Y family) = 𝟙 _
